one_liner: Licensed, bilingual counselor who runs court-ordered domestic violence intervention groups and manages a caseload of Spanish-speaking offenders under DC supervision.
fit_summary: This GS-12 role requires an independent clinical license (LICSW, LPC, LMFT or similar), professional-level Spanish, and a year of GS-11-equivalent experience facilitating domestic violence or cognitive-behavioral interventions for high-risk offenders. Nothing on file shows Daniel has a license, Spanish fluency, or clinical offender-treatment experience. Daniel's emergency-management consulting and policy strengths don't map to these hard requirements.
eligibility: Open to the public, federal transition (fed-transition) and veterans hiring paths, so Daniel can apply without federal status.
Selective Placement Factor 2: you must hold a current, unrestricted independent license (LISW, LICSW, LPC, LMFT or comparable) and upload a copy, or you lose consideration.
Selective Placement Factor 1: you must read, write and speak Spanish and English at a professional level, including written case documentation.
One year of specialized experience equivalent to GS-11 facilitating evidence-based DV or cognitive-behavioral interventions, managing complex DV cases and conducting advanced risk assessments.
Basic requirement: a behavioral or social science degree (or 24 semester hours), or equivalent experience, with transcripts required for any claimed education.
strategy: Before investing time, confirm honestly whether you hold an independent clinical license and professional Spanish; if not, skip this posting, because both are pass/fail screens.
If you do qualify, state your license number, state and expiration on your two-page resume and upload the license copy before the November 11, 2026 deadline.

Frame any IEM work only where it is truthfully relevant, such as interagency coordination, community partner collaboration or program evaluation, and don't stretch it into clinical intervention experience.
Answer the questionnaire conservatively, since overstating qualifications can remove you, and prepare for the USA Hire assessment's cut score.

A better use of your time: target CSOSA, DOJ, FEMA or Virginia/NoVA posts in community outreach, program analysis, emergency management or legislative affairs, where your IEM and policy background fits.
resume_bullets: Coordinated with [number] government and community partners on [disaster recovery/preparedness program] for [client agency], [hours/week], [dates].
Evaluated [program/process] outcomes and recommended improvements adopted by [client], resulting in [result you can verify].
Served as primary point of contact for [stakeholder group], resolving [type of issues] and maintaining relationships across [number] organizations.
interview_questions: Describe how you facilitate a DV intervention group when a participant minimizes or denies the abuse.
How do you prioritize victim safety when a participant misses sessions?
Give an example of adapting a curriculum for Spanish-speaking participants while maintaining model fidelity.
Tell us about a high-risk case where your risk assessment changed the supervision plan.
watch_outs: Hard licensure requirement: without a current independent clinical license, your application will be rejected automatically.
Professional-level Spanish is a selective factor and may be tested or verified.
Category rating gives veterans' preference eligibles selection priority, which lowers odds for non-veterans.
